###############################################################################
# PhD Dissertation Case Study: "Soup to Nuts" Spatial Data Mining Pipeline
# Script: PhD_Spatial_Clustering_Simulation.R
###############################################################################

```{r}
# Load required packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dbscan)
  library(cluster)
  library(factoextra)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(viridis)
  library(dendextend)
})
```

```{r}
# Set seed for complete scientific reproducibility
set.seed(2026)
```


```{r}
#==============================================================================
# STEP 1: Synthetic Spatial Coordinate and Covariate Simulation
#==============================================================================
cat("--- STEP 1: Simulating Complex Geospatial Features ---\n")

# Geometry A: Crescent / Arc Structure (Non-convex spatial corridor, N = 400)
theta <- runif(400, 0, pi)
r <- 3.5 + rnorm(400, mean = 0, sd = 0.15)
arc_x <- r * cos(theta) + 5
arc_y <- r * sin(theta) + 5
crescent_data <- data.table(x = arc_x, y = arc_y, true_entity = "Arc_Corridor")
```
```{r}
# Geometry B: Dense Gaussian Environmental Core (Spherical, N = 250)
core_x <- rnorm(250, mean = 5, sd = 0.4)
core_y <- rnorm(250, mean = 3.5, sd = 0.4)
gaussian_data <- data.table(x = core_x, y = core_y, true_entity = "Dense_Core")

# Geometry C: Diffuse Background Environmental Noise (Uniform Spatial Noise, N = 75)
noise_x <- runif(75, min = 0, max = 10)
noise_y <- runif(75, min = 0, max = 9)
noise_data <- data.table(x = noise_x, y = noise_y, true_entity = "Background_Noise")

# Combine synthetic dataset
sim_spatial <- rbind(crescent_data, gaussian_data, noise_data)
sim_spatial[, point_id := 1:.N]

cat(sprintf("Simulated %d spatial points across 3 distinct topological structures.\n", nrow(sim_spatial)))
```

```{r}
# Plot raw spatial coordinate distribution
ggplot(sim_spatial, aes(x = x, y = y, color = true_entity)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Arc_Corridor" = "#2E86C1", "Dense_Core" = "#28B463", "Background_Noise" = "#E74C3C")) +
  labs(title = "Simulated Spatial Data",
       subtitle = "Complex Geometry: Non-Convex Crescent + Gaussian Core + Uniform Noise",
       x = "X Coordinate (km)", y = "Y Coordinate (km)", color = "Ground Truth Geometry") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# STEP 2: Spatial Feature Scaling and Distance Matrix Formulation
#==============================================================================
cat("\n--- STEP 2: Preprocessing and Distance Matrix Computation ---\n")

spatial_coords <- as.matrix(sim_spatial[, .(x, y)])
scaled_coords <- scale(spatial_coords)

# Compute Pairwise Euclidean Distance Matrix
spatial_dist <- dist(scaled_coords, method = "euclidean")
```

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# STEP 3: k-NN Knee Plot Diagnostic & DBSCAN Calibration
#==============================================================================
cat("\n--- STEP 3: DBSCAN Parameter Calibration via k-NN Plot ---\n")

# Spatial dimension d = 2 -> Baseline minPts = 4 (increased to 5 for noise robustness)
# choosing the min points and epsilon 
target_minPts <- 5
kNNdistplot(scaled_coords, k = target_minPts)
abline(h=0.15, lty=2)
```

```{r}
# Find Knee Point programmatically via max distance from chord line
knn_distances <- kNNdist(scaled_coords, k = target_minPts)
sorted_knn <- sort(knn_distances)
n_points <- length(sorted_knn)
x1 <- 1; y1 <- sorted_knn[1]
x2 <- n_points; y2 <- sorted_knn[n_points]
```

```{r}
# Line distance calculation
a <- y2 - y1
b <- x1 - x2
c <- x2 * y1 - x1 * y2
distances_to_line <- abs(a * (1:n_points) + b * sorted_knn + c) / sqrt(a^2 + b^2)
knee_index <- which.max(distances_to_line)
optimal_eps <- sorted_knn[knee_index]


cat(sprintf("Automated k-NN Knee Diagnostic: Optimal Epsilon = %.4f (at minPts = %d)\n", optimal_eps, target_minPts))
```

```{r}
# Fit DBSCAN
dbscan_fit <- dbscan(scaled_coords, eps = optimal_eps, minPts = target_minPts)
sim_spatial[, dbscan_cluster := dbscan_fit$cluster]

cat(sprintf("DBSCAN Execution Results: %d Clusters Identified, %d Noise Points Isolated.\n",
            max(dbscan_fit$cluster), sum(dbscan_fit$cluster == 0)))

ggplot(sim_spatial, aes(x, y, color = as.factor(dbscan_cluster), shape = dbscan_cluster == 0)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 4)) +
  labs(title = "DBSCAN (Arbitrary Geometry + Noise Isolation)") + theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# STEP 4: Agglomerative Hierarchical Profiling and Cut-Tree Analysis
#==============================================================================
cat("\n--- STEP 4: Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering (AGNES) ---\n")

# Fit AGNES with Ward's linkage
agnes_ward <- agnes(scaled_coords, method = "ward")
cat(sprintf("AGNES Agglomerative Coefficient (Ward's Method): %.4f\n", agnes_ward$ac))
```

```{r}
# Cut hierarchical tree at k = 3 (expecting 2 main clusters + noise)
hier_clusters_k3 <- cutree(as.hclust(agnes_ward), k = 3)
# This is hierarchical cluster assignment to determine where you cut the tree
sim_spatial[, hier_cluster := hier_clusters_k3]
```

```{r}
# Fit k-means as baseline model for comparison
set.seed(2026)
kmeans_fit <- kmeans(scaled_coords, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
sim_spatial[, kmeans_cluster := kmeans_fit$cluster]
```


```{r}
#==============================================================================
# STEP 5: Comparative Model Evaluation
#==============================================================================
cat("\n--- STEP 5: Comparative Evaluation Across Spatial Algorithms ---\n")

# Compute Silhouette Widths
sil_kmeans <- silhouette(kmeans_fit$cluster, spatial_dist)
sil_hier <- silhouette(hier_clusters_k3, spatial_dist)

# DBSCAN Silhouette (excluding noise points label = 0)
non_noise_idx <- which(dbscan_fit$cluster > 0)
if (length(non_noise_idx) > 0) {
  sil_dbscan <- silhouette(dbscan_fit$cluster[non_noise_idx], dist(scaled_coords[non_noise_idx, ]))
  avg_sil_dbscan <- mean(sil_dbscan[, 3])
} else {
  avg_sil_dbscan <- NA
}

avg_sil_kmeans <- mean(sil_kmeans[, 3])
avg_sil_hier <- mean(sil_hier[, 3])

cat("\n===================================================================\n")
cat("           SPATIAL ALGORITHM BENCHMARK SUMMARY TABLE\n")
cat("===================================================================\n")
cat(sprintf("Algorithm      | Clusters Found | Noise Isolated | Avg Silhouette Width\n"))
cat("-------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat(sprintf("k-Means (k=3)  | 3              | 0              | %.4f\n", avg_sil_kmeans))
cat(sprintf("AGNES (Ward k=3)| 3              | 0              | %.4f\n", avg_sil_hier))
cat(sprintf("DBSCAN (eps=%.2f)| %-14d | %-14d | %.4f\n", 
            optimal_eps, max(dbscan_fit$cluster), sum(dbscan_fit$cluster == 0), avg_sil_dbscan))
cat("===================================================================\n")
```
# the lower values are better for the silhoutte 


```{r}
# Visual comparison of spatial cluster partitioning
p_ground <- ggplot(sim_spatial, aes(x, y, color = true_entity)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) + labs(title = "Ground Truth Geometries") + theme_bw()
print(p_ground)
```

```{r}
p_km <- ggplot(sim_spatial, aes(x, y, color = as.factor(kmeans_cluster))) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) + labs(title = "k-Means (Forced Spherical Boundaries)") + theme_bw()
print(p_km)
```

```{r}
p_hc <- ggplot(sim_spatial, aes(x, y, color = as.factor(hier_cluster))) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) + labs(title = "Hierarchical AGNES (Ward's Linkage)") + theme_bw()
print(p_hc)

# Remember that Agnes is only working off the (x,y) distances so it can't capture the strutures of the clusters in the dataset 
# it can't handle local density 
```
```{r}
p_db <- ggplot(sim_spatial, aes(x, y, color = as.factor(dbscan_cluster), shape = dbscan_cluster == 0)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 4)) +
  labs(title = "DBSCAN (Arbitrary Geometry + Noise Isolation)") + theme_bw()


# Print DBSCAN spatial plot
print(p_db)
```
